from collections.abc import Iterable, Callable, Awaitable
from typing import TypeVar

T = TypeVar("T")


class Runner:
    @decorate
    async def in_order[T](
        self, items: Iterable[T], step: Callable[[T], Awaitable[None]], *, reason: str
    ) -> None:
        """Run supplied work in order."""
        for item in items:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await step(item)

    async def in_order_steps(
        self, steps: Iterable[Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]], *, reason: str
    ) -> None:
        """Run supplied work in order."""
        del reason
        for step in steps:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await step()
